cases.evidence: At app-source commit e89265c0dda7dc88a7d7a7f75abd5010c25a48c9, TDLibUpdateBuffer adds a hard-bounded overflow reserve: at most one event for each of 20 client lanes, one unrouteable lane, and additional reserved bytes capped at 25% of the primary byte budget. Fix 6c6fff49d6c43746b3990de178b723d1eaf75172 rejects oversized queue events and closes the receive gateway with an explicit error; the C bridge checks a 16 MiB maximum before copying TDLib's borrowed buffer. Added regression tests cover rejection while empty and fail-closed/send rejection. cases.name: Удаление незавершённого локального входа
cases.expected: Удаляется только профиль без подтверждённого TelegramUserID. Удаление фиксируется до close; рестарт не открывает профиль с pending marker. Ключи и файлы удаляются после TDLib Closed и снятия route; ошибки допускают безопасный повтор. Подтверждённый аккаунт этим действием удалить нельзя.
cases.method: Core failure-injection tests + exact-source native Dev.app UI smoke; no Telegram credentials required
cases.evidence: App source d57d569 adds an explicit “Удалить незавершённый вход…” action, durable unverified-removal marker, identity-association guard, restore exclusion, and retryable Keychain/file/catalogue cleanup after authorizationStateClosed and route removal. Local serial suite passed 134/134, including verified-identity rejection, no-restore while pending, retry after file failure, and retaining files when key deletion fails. Native menu journey and actual TDLib close remain unverified pending exact-SHA Dev.app smoke; no real login or confirmed account was used.

cases.name: Страна на первом экране входа
cases.expected: На пустом каталоге доступен локальный список стран и кодов; регион macOS только предлагает выбор, невыбранная страна не превращается в +1; полный номер с + принимается. Профиль и TDLib runtime возникают только после явного продолжения или QR.
cases.method: AppKit empty-catalogue UI + deterministic catalog/phone tests
cases.evidence: Pinned 245-region bundled calling-code table from Google libphonenumber v9.0.41; exact source/license hashes and reproducible generator are recorded in COUNTRY-DATA.lock.json. Core serial suite passed 152/152 for catalog/phone-input source be58d83. Current AppKit ordering fix is source 94740d3: clean arm64 Dev.app built in 9.12s with ad-hoc signature verification; AX and screenshot show first-run country selector, locale-suggested Thailand +66, phone field, Continue and QR before entering any credentials. Empty profile catalogue shows the form before API hash lookup; pressing Continue/QR is the only path to profile creation, and credential lookup precedes catalogue.addProfile. No number, code, account, session, or profile created. Current-source full Swift suite compiled but was interrupted after a silent runner exceeded 60s; hosted CI 38466197778 cancelled during the test-runner phase at the configured five-minute job limit, with no test result; cancellation initiator unknown. Run 38464148650 for preceding source be58d83 timed out/cancelled; retry API denied 403. Public Site v153 needs update to correct the earlier not-yet-smoked note. On exact app source 94740d3, focused tests cancelledQueuedStartupDoesNotRunAfterItsPermitBecomesAvailable and twentyProfileRestoreStartupRegistrationSurvivesStallFailureRetryAndSelectionChanges each pass locally under Xcode 27 / Swift 6.4. Full-suite status remains unverified. Exact checkpoint 43980cf0f654d7d0d38c71b5ec73154871c26400 was rebuilt into the one canonical Dev.app using a fresh, isolated support root; AX now verifies country +66, phone field, Continue, QR and neutral first-run status without a UUID profile, with no credentials entered. The previous default support root was preserved; saved-profile Keychain restore there remains partial. The routine Dev.app script now defaults to a fresh isolated root; exact local smoke at checkpoint 3cba4c5 shows country +66, phone field, Continue, QR and neutral prompt without UUID profiles. No phone/code entered. Current app source fa80d5a5f77b1fecf583754f3fe5cf69209be75b adds bilingual country-name search and retains the selected region as a separate marked item while filtering. Focused search regression passed 1/1; exact-source local serial suite passed 163/163 in 0.426s on arm64e / Xcode 27.0 / Swift 6.4. Exact-source hosted macOS CI 38497467214 passed the runner probe but was cancelled at its five-minute job limit during the full suite; no hosted suite result is claimed. Pinned TDLib/arm64 Dev.app workflow 38497467210 passed. The one canonical local Dev.app at /private/tmp/NeTelegram-Dev.app was rebuilt from fa80d5a5f77b1fecf583754f3fe5cf69209be75b in 0.18s, ad-hoc codesign verification passed, and accessibility smoke searched 'Canada', found '🇨🇦 Канада +1', and selected it; current Thailand remains explicit when filtered. No phone, code, account, or session was entered. AUTH05 remains partial pending real auth and broader flow/accessibility coverage.
